title: About A Pale Interval
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1461 recent saved-signal files and 1 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @terrorism______: °ʚ(๑මั‸මั๑)ɞ♡°. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A Pale Interval: Landscape still life on pale gray: a large rounded foil-print fragment and a smaller companion flank a broad empty channel. The larger pairs a cyan eye-bearing curve with a pink curl beneath violet arcs and a descending cream taper. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Dark rounded upper-right foil rim of the larger illustrated fragment and Dark rounded foil edge beside the cyan eye-bearing curve and pink curl.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
